title: Café Aquarium Feeding Frenzy
description: The player manages a surreal café aquarium where a giant coffee mug serves as a fish tank. A face character acts as the café patron who orders fish to be caught and served. The player must click to spawn bait, lure the Barramundi fish into the mug, adjust water temperature via a slider, and satisfy the patron's randomized orders within a time limit.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load BarramundiFish.glb, coffeeMug.glb, and facecap.glb. Scene setup: Place the coffeeMug model scaled up 8x at center as a giant fish tank. Fill it with a semi-transparent blue plane simulating water inside. Place the BarramundiFish scaled appropriately swimming in a circular path around the mug exterior. Position the facecap model to the right as a café patron, gently bobbing with a sine-wave idle animation. Camera: perspective at position (0, 5, 12) looking at origin. Lighting: ambient light 0.4 intensity, directional light from upper-left, point light inside the mug tinted aqua. Game mechanics requiring 8 interaction steps: (1) Click a Start button in an HTML overlay to begin a 60-second countdown timer. (2) The face patron displays a random order text like 'I want a warm fish!' with a target temperature range shown. (3) Player clicks anywhere on the ground plane to drop bait (a small yellow sphere). (4) The fish detects bait within radius 3 units and swims toward it using lerp interpolation. (5) Player must click the fish when it is within 1.5 units of the mug opening to scoop it inside, triggering a splash particle burst. (6) A temperature slider (HTML range input 0-100) appears; player must adjust it to match the patron order's target range within ±5 degrees. (7) Click a Serve button to deliver the fish, which plays a scale-up animation on the mug. (8) The patron face morphs a smile blend shape if temperature is correct, or a frown if wrong, and score updates. Validate each step: bait must exist before fish moves, fish must be near mug before capture, temperature must be in range before serving. Display score and timer in an HTML overlay. After 60 seconds show final score. Use requestAnimationFrame loop for fish swimming, bait logic, and patron idle animation.
